title: Evaluate raw YAML pattern hits
description:
Purpose: Grade whether a YAML heuristic fired before classification. YAML is the rulebook. The grade is on the raw hits those rules emit, so a miss can be blamed on the heuristic, the classifier, or graph mapping.

Exclusions: changing the YAML heuristics in this planning epic.

Definition of done: stories specify matching raw pattern gold to engine hits, and separate miss attribution.
